thesis: Technical elegance must account for displaced complexity, error, repair and whose purposes the design serves.

ideas.statement: A responsible system makes limits examinable and locates complexity where it can be managed; minimal gestures or clean diagrams can conceal losses.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The ordered-list search depends on maintenance and access assumptions; redundancy can protect against failure while obsolete duplication can rightly be removed.
